description:
Fix ISS-024: plan-review deliberation can never produce agreed findings.

## Why
`computeAgreement` in `src/backends/deliberation.ts` (exported, ~line 104) matches findings only when both have non-null `file` AND `line` (`keyOf()` ~line 32 returns null otherwise; `dedupExact()` ~line 81 routes null-key findings into `keyless`, and lines 114-115 push every keyless finding straight to `divergent`). Plan findings (see `PlanFindingSchema` in `src/review/types.ts`) never have file/line, so plan deliberation ALWAYS returns `agreed: []` — proven live: 0 agreed / 11 divergent when both providers flagged the same 3 concerns in near-identical words.

## Step 1 — Gather data BEFORE designing (do not skip)
Run at least 3 live plan reviews in deliberate mode and save both providers' raw findings. How: create a scratch config `{"codex_path": "/Users/amirshayegh/.local/bin/codex", "mode": "deliberate"}`, then `RB_CONFIG_PATH=<that file> node dist/index.js review-plan --plan <plan.md> --json`. Use real plans (e.g. draft plans for T-035/T-036 from this repo's issues). For each same-concern pair across providers, record: category strings used, description wording overlap, ordering. Save the analysis as a storybloq note (like N-002 was for T-029). The matcher design MUST cite this data.

## Step 2 — Design a plan-finding match key
Candidates to evaluate against the data (pick what the data supports, not what sounds elegant):
- normalized category (reuse `normalizeCategory()` ~line 61) + token-overlap similarity on descriptions (e.g. Jaccard over lowercased word sets with a tuned threshold);
- OR add a short `topic` field to the model-facing plan response schema so providers self-tag findings. CAUTION if you touch the response schema: per lesson L-014, EVERY property must be in `required` recursively or live Codex rejects the whole request with invalid_json_schema — mock tests will NOT catch this; the recursive lock test in `src/backends/orchestrator.test.ts` must stay green and you must live-probe Codex once.

## Step 3 — Implement
Keep `computeAgreement` for code findings untouched (T-029 tuned it on live data; do not regress it). Add a separate plan path — either a new `computePlanAgreement()` or a strategy parameter — called from `combinePlan()` (~line 226). Greedy 1:1 pairing like the code path (see lines 120-150 for the pattern): each finding pairs at most once, deterministic tiebreaks, keep the higher-severity representative.

## Step 4 — Tests + live verification
- Unit tests colocated in `src/backends/deliberation.test.ts` (Vitest, follow existing describe blocks): same-concern pairs merge, distinct concerns stay divergent, determinism, severity-representative choice.
- Full gate: `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npx vitest run` (all ~810 tests).
- Live: rerun a deliberate plan review and confirm `deliberation.agreed` is non-empty on a plan where both providers genuinely flag the same concern; confirm no false-merges (two DIFFERENT concerns must not merge).

## Conventions (mandatory)
TypeScript strict, no `any`/`as` escapes; Result<T> pattern (no throws); ESM imports with `.js` suffix; TDD (write failing tests first); no AI names in commit messages. Resolve ISS-024 in the same commit (set status resolved with a resolution note).
title: Plan-finding agreement matching: gather live two-provider plan data, then a plan-specific match key (ISS-024)
